scheme_name: Marriage Assistance to Normal Persons Marrying Speech and Hearing Impaired Persons
other_conditions: Both spouses must be married to each other, with one being a normal person and the other a speech and hearing impaired person.
Both spouses must be older than 18 years.
Increased assistance is available if either spouse holds a degree or diploma.
benefits_summary: Provides ₹25,000 assistance (₹12,500 National Savings Certificate + ₹12,500 cash) to eligible couples, with the amount doubled to ₹50,000 for couples where either spouse has a degree or diploma, along with a certificate of appreciation and an 8‑gram gold coin.
